method: EXIF orientation; optional four-corner homography to physical paper aspect; local 95th-percentile paper RGB normalization; neutral highlight cleanup with protection for faint colored strokes; optional rigid deskew with white canvas expansion; Lanczos display resize; JPEG 94, 4:4:4.
limits: Display correction, not a calibrated measurement of ink color. No stroke replacement, inpainting, sharpening or generated artwork. A homography does not flatten paper curl.
